caption: The drawing consists of two separate rectangular sections on a plain, off-white background. The top section features horizontal handwriting in black and red ink, with decorative flourishes in the form of a multicolored swirl at the top, primarily composed of red, green, and yellow hues. Below the text, there is a musical staff with musical notes, and a small bird colored in brown, yellow, and red is perched near the bottom right, next to a stylized abstract plant motif on both ends. The lower section contains a floral design vertically centered within a rectangle. The flower has broad petals with stripes of yellow, red, green, and blue, and green leaves branching out below and to the sides. Handwritten text in black ink is incorporated into the spaces around and within the flower and leaves, and the entire lower panel is bordered by parallel colored lines. Both sections have visible signs of aging with a slight tan tint to the paper.
title: Fractur Paintings (Upper-a Hymn; Lower- Religious Motto)
